{{Quote|All of the Iterations are implanted with basic knowledge roughly equivalent to that of a human adolescent. Otherwise they would be difficult to deal with when they awakened.|Nyss Nenn|<ref name="Riptide (novel)">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref>}}
'''Iterations''' were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] used by the [[One Sith]] as their sleeper agents. In [[41 ABY]], [[the Iteration]] of [[Jaden Korr]] was created by the One Sith.
